A nice buffet at the Show
Jun 2026 • Couples
My husband and I had the buffet dinner at voco Scenia Nha Trang last weekend, and we had a lovely experience overall.

What we enjoyed most was the service. The staff were genuinely friendly and helpful, especially the hostess at the restaurant entrance and Truc, our waitress. She really went the extra mile to make sure we could enjoy our meal, and we truly appreciated her kindness and attentiveness.

My favorite part was the salad bar. The selection was fresh, and the dressings were absolutely delicious. We also enjoyed the fish and the food in general.

The only dishes that didn't quite meet our expectations were the lobster and the beef steak. Perhaps we were a little too excited about the lobster, but we would have enjoyed it more if it had been served warmer. We were seated directly underneath the air conditioning, so it's possible the food cooled down more quickly after it reached our table. The beef steak was also a little chewy and wasn't particularly memorable.

The desserts looked fantastic, even though we didn't have much room left to try many of them.

The restaurant itself was beautiful, and we were given a table with a wonderful sea view, which made the evening even more special. The only small suggestion would be to have cozier lighting to create a better atmosphere.

A special thank you once again to Truc for her fabulous service. She made our evening even more enjoyable, and we look forward to coming back in the future.

Great experience at The Show – voco Nha Trang
Jun 2026 • Family
My family had such a lovely time at The Show Restaurant – voco Nha Trang. The place is beautiful, very classy but still comfortable, and it really made our dinner feel special.
Big thanks to Jessi (Lành), Ngân, Jo, and Hương for being so kind and attentive. Everyone was super friendly and made us feel right at home.
And a special shout-out to Nam (FBD) – he took such great care of us the whole time. You can really tell he loves what he does, and it made our experience even better.
Thank you all for a wonderful evening. We’ll definitely come back next time we’re in Nha Trang.
